scope: Sequence metadata and hypothetical missingness only. No phenotype input, fitting, estimated missingness rate or phenotype power calculation.

missingness_models.A: For each of 181 selected genotype IDs, each of seven required fields is independently missing with probability p. A genotype is complete only if all seven fields are present. Shared IDs reuse the same field realization in every square.
missingness_models.B: Each of 32 related seed groups is independently absent with probability p; all selected genotypes in that group are unavailable together.
missingness_models.C: Each ID in the fixed global union of masked target IDs is independently unavailable with probability p. All nonmasked genotypes remain complete. Shared target IDs reuse one realization. Structural multi-mask exclusions remain excluded from prediction.

stages.descriptive: Every original square is eligible iff all four corners are complete.
stages.known_corner_prediction: Only fixed exactly-one-global-mask squares are considered; all three known corners must be complete. Target availability is not inspected at this stage.
stages.prediction_evaluation: Only fixed exactly-one-global-mask squares are considered; all four corners must be complete.
stages.predicted_but_unscorable: Known-corner prediction succeeds but the target genotype is unavailable.

reporting.pass_rates: Unconditional coverage pass rates for descriptive, known-corner prediction and evaluation, and both arms jointly for each stage.
reporting.conditional_convention: Report numerator, conditioning denominator, proportion and sqrt(p_hat*(1-p_hat)/denominator). A zero conditioning denominator gives null proportion and MCSE.
reporting.MCSE_scope: Simulation integration error under these stipulated models only. Not biological uncertainty. A plug-in zero MCSE at zero observed events does not prove an event impossible.

verification.exact_controls: For every family test p=0 and p=1 deterministically. At p=0 all metadata-eligible cases remain; at p=1 descriptive and evaluation coverage are zero. In C at p=1 all structurally eligible predictions are made but unscorable.
verification.scalar_reference: Independently reconstruct counts and coverage using Python ID/group sets for the first 64 generated draws in each scenario.
verification.algebraic_checks: Evaluation cases are always a subset of predictions and descriptive cases; predicted count equals evaluated plus unscorable; distinct targets never exceed cases.
verification.failure: Stop on any input-hash, runtime, exact-control, reference or stage-containment mismatch; do not change rates or retain favorable scenarios.

limitations: These missingness rates are hypothetical, not inferred from the author deposit.
Coverage alone cannot demonstrate both class labels, meaningful margins or successful prediction.
The models cannot correct outcome-dependent missingness or establish independent assay validation.
No resplitting, refitting, imputation or relaxed coverage threshold is allowed.
